long long f(long long n) {
    if (n <= 6) return n;
    int d = digits(n);
    long long a = makeOnes(d);
    long long inc = a;
    long long diff = n;
    int c = 0;
    while (a < n) {
        c++;
        diff = n - a;
        a += inc;
    }
    long long res;
    if (c > 0) {
        res = min(c * d + f(diff), (c + 1) * d + f(a - n));
    } else {
        res = (c + 1) * d + f(a - n);
    }
    long long next = makeOnes(d + 1);
    if (next - n < n) {
        res = min(res, d + 1 + f(next - n));
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << f(n) << endl;
    return 0;
}
